announcement_support.other: Support from the people who built it

noscript.other: JavaScript is required for cart and checkout. Product information and support remain available without it.

footer_description.other: Compact filling equipment, connections and service parts from Brewket AS in Skjold, Norway.

home_intro.other: Compact dual-head filling for cans and bottles. Pre-purge with CO₂, program the level once, then keep your line moving.

home_hero_alt.other: DuoFiller Core G3 dual-head can and bottle filler

home_flow_label.other: Approximate flow at 1 bar beverage pressure

process_title.other: Less ritual between the keg and the can.

process_intro.other: Program the level once. Each short press runs a CO₂ purge before the beverage starts flowing, then stops automatically at the target.

process_one_text.other: Position a can or bottle beneath either head and start the sequence with its dedicated button.

process_two_text.other: A slow CO₂ pre-purge helps reduce oxygen contact before the beverage enters the container.

process_three_text.other: Sensor mode handles cans; timer mode handles bottles and highly carbonated beverages.

feature_title.other: No tiny screen. No cloud dependency.

feature_intro.other: Core controls stay on the machine. Advanced settings live on a locally hosted Wi-Fi interface, available from a standard browser when you need them.

feature_one_text.other: Pinch valves close flexible tubing without adding narrow cavities that encourage turbulence.

feature_two_text.other: Run water, line cleaner and sanitiser through the same filling cycle used for beverages.

feature_three_text.other: Mount directly to the wall or use a VESA 100 arm or stand to keep the bench clear.

categories_title.other: The right connection, without the guesswork.

category_legacy_title.other: G1 and G2 parts still matter.

spec_intro.other: Use the official manual for complete installation, safety and operating instructions.

support_title.other: Read it. Connect it. Fill with confidence.

support_intro.other: Manuals, assembly, cleaning and troubleshooting stay easy to find—whether your filler is current or discontinued.

contact_form_note.other: This form opens your email application. Nothing is sent until you review and send the message there.
